mentions.name: Hypertext argument tree mapper
mentions.description: A hypertext tool for mapping reasoning and arguments. AI generates a tree of arguments, each given an initial 'debatable' rating on truthfulness, and a UI lets a human dig through the tree and mark statements on a 1-5 scale of false/dubious/debatable/plausible/true. Demonstrated by evaluating the author's Massachusetts ballot.
mentions.source_excerpt: I use hypertext to map reasoning and arguments. I have AI skills to map out a tree of arguments, all of which are given an initial "debatable" rating on truthfulness. I have a UI in which a human can dig through the tree and mark statements on a 1-5 scale of false/dubious/debatable/plausible/true.
mentions.author: brlewis
